norms.text: Each lot is numbered and passes down one diver family.
The families share the tenders moored over the lots.
The takings and the drownings go into the same tally book.

taboos.text: Teaching an outsider to work the lots.

values.text: A long breath and a full net.

contempts.text: Outsiders who think a pearl lies loose on the sand.

place.text: Numbered lots inside the offshore bar, worked from tenders.

work.text: The deep lots pay best and kill divers.

people.text: Diver families from Archon, each on its own lot.

danger.text: The deep lots drown divers; jellies drift over the beds.

directions.text: Ways are given by the shore: the spit, the landing below Portdun Mont, then Archon.

addressTerms.text: Neighbours by lot number or name; strangers plainly.

neverSaid.text: How many a family has lost on its lot.

grievances.text: A lot with no living heir waits to be reassigned.

views.text: Archon buys the pearls and never comes out to the lots.

dissent.text: She brings the day's net up from the deep lot herself (record notes) and knows what the deep lot costs.
